definitions.gloss: two nights (of lodging); a two-night stay
definitions.explanation: Two nights spent away from home in paid or borrowed accommodation. Japanese counts trips by nights rather than days, so a stay is booked and described in {泊|はく} first and days second.

examples.japanese: {二泊|にはく}⟦{予約|よやく}しました→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{二泊三日|にはくみっか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です。
examples.english: I'm planning a three-day, two-night trip to Kyoto.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一泊|いっぱく}→一泊：08892_ippaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{楽|たの}しくて→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧{二泊|にはく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{延|の}ばした→延ばす：28291_nobasu⟧。
examples.english: I had meant to stay one night, but I was enjoying it so much that I stretched it to two.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二泊|にはく}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{機内持|きないも}ち{込|こ}み→機内持ち込み：10204_kinaimochikomi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{足|た}ります→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
examples.english: The business trip is two nights, so carry-on luggage will be enough.

notes:
The counter {泊|はく} counts nights of lodging. Watch the sound changes: ⟦{一泊|いっぱく}→一泊：08892_ippaku⟧, {二泊|にはく}, {三泊|さんぱく}, {四泊|よんはく}, {六泊|ろっぱく}, {八泊|はっぱく}, {十泊|じっぱく}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二泊三日|にはくみっか}: three days and two nights
- {二泊|にはく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to stay two nights
- {二泊分|にはくぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: the charge for two nights

USAGE:
Trip lengths are stated nights-first as ⟦{一泊二日|いっぱくふつか}→一泊二日：26883_ippakufutsuka⟧, {二泊三日|にはくみっか}, {三泊四日|さんぱくよっか} — the reverse of the English order, and the form used in tour names and travel plans.
